trial_court: Family Court, Manipur at Lamphelpat, Imphal (Mat. App. No. 14 of 2025)
case_name: Shri Huirem Jayenta Singh vs Nemo
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2018 but had marital discord and jointly approached the Family Court for divorce by mutual consent under Section 13 B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The trial court rejected their joint plea for waiver of the cooling period, leading to this appeal.

legal_principles.principle: The court may refer parties to mediation in a divorce case.
legal_principles.held: In and vide order dated 19.09.2025, this Court referred the parties to mediation.

legal_principles.principle: A settlement reached through mediation can be a valid basis for divorce.
legal_principles.held: The parties have arrived at a settlement and the terms of settlement have been reduced to writing on 06.10.2025.

outcome.final_order: The parties have arrived at a settlement and the terms of settlement have been reduced to writing on 10/6/2025. The court has accepted the settlement agreement and disposed of the appeal.
